$description: OHarness design tokens. DTCG format (https://www.designtokens.org): $type, $value, $description, groups. Themes are carried in $extensions.oh.themes because DTCG has no theme object: $value is the default Graphite (dark) theme, themes.light is Ivory. $extensions.oh.css names the CSS custom property in frontend/src/app/globals.css that must equal the value (checked by npm test); status is code (mirrors the app today), hardcoded (value lives in a component, no variable yet), tailwind (comes from the Tailwind scale) or proposed (new, not yet in the app; none today).

color.$description: Warm graphite is the default theme; warm ivory is the light theme. Chroma means state, never mood: one signal hue, amber for attention, red for fault. If a colour carries no information it is grey. Every colour here is declared in globals.css and checked by npm test.

sub-000.$description: App substrate: window, page and canvas background. Text on it uses ink-primary, ink-dim, ink-mute.

sub-100.$description: Raised surface: panels, composer, floating sheets, inputs.

sub-200.$description: Contained surface: inset fields, secondary buttons, user messages, hover on list rows.

sub-300.$description: Pressed state and strong hover of contained surfaces; node handles. Body text on it needs ink-dim or brighter.

sub-400.$description: Scrollbar thumbs and the highest elevation step. Never a text ground.

line.$description: Hairline around panels and floats. Decorative separation only: about 1.6:1, so it never marks a control edge on its own.

line-soft.$description: Dividers inside a panel and the border of inset surfaces.

line-strong.$description: Border of interactive controls (input, secondary button, checkbox). 3.2:1 or better on sub-000 to sub-200 in both themes, which WCAG 1.4.11 requires for a control edge.

ink-primary.$description: Headings, titles and anything the person reads first. 11.8:1 or better on sub-000 to sub-300 in both themes.

ink-dim.$description: Body copy and conversation text. 7.5:1 or better on every substrate.

ink-mute.$description: Secondary copy: descriptions, metadata, placeholders. 5.1:1 or better on every substrate.

ink-faint.$description: Quietest ink: decorative glyphs and non-essential hints. Corrected from 0.600 and 0.560 so it holds 4.5:1 on all four substrates in both themes. Reading text still uses the three levels above it.

signal.$description: Mineral teal: primary action fill, focus ring, live state, selected indicator. Under 5% of a viewport. As a fill, border or focus ring it holds 3:1 on every substrate. As text use signal-text, because signal itself is 4.3:1 on Ivory sub-200 and 3.8:1 on sub-300.

signal-deep.$description: Pressed state of a signal fill and the border of a selected control.

signal-ink.$description: Text and icons on a signal fill. 7.6:1 in Graphite, 4.9:1 in Ivory.

signal-text.$description: Signal-coloured text (links, active tab label) on sub-000 to sub-300. Same as signal in Graphite (5.5:1 or better); a deeper teal in Ivory, where signal itself falls to 3.8:1 on sub-300 (measured 4.6:1 or better).

warn.$description: Amber: attention and decision. Fill, marker or border only. As text it is 3.3:1 on Ivory sub-000, so text uses warn-text.

warn-text.$description: Warning text on sub-000 to sub-300. Measured 4.6:1 or better on all four substrates in both themes (script: check-contrast.mjs).

fault.$description: Error fill, marker and border. As text it is 3.6:1 on Graphite sub-000, so text uses fault-text.

fault-text.$description: Error text and inline validation messages on sub-000 to sub-300. Measured 4.6:1 or better on all four substrates in both themes. Always paired with a word or icon.

role-agent.$description: Marker for an Agent node. Small square or dot only, always with the role name beside it. 3.7:1 on Graphite sub-000, 4.7:1 on Ivory.

role-gate.$description: Marker for a Gate node (checkpoint). Same hue as warn on purpose.

role-tool.$description: Marker for a Tool node, with the role name always beside it. Lightened from L 0.470 so it holds 3:1 on Graphite sub-000 and sub-100.

role-decision.$description: Marker for the experimental Decision node (ADR-0005). Never reads as a Gate or HITL because it is never a real gate.

overlay-backdrop.$description: Scrim behind sheets and the command palette.

surface-highlight.$description: 1px inner top highlight on raised panels, instead of a drop shadow.

nilo-body.$description: Nilo's body and ear tufts. Follows --signal, so she turns with the theme: the only Nilo colour that does.

nilo-eye.$description: Eye whites, thought dots and sleep Zs. Fixed in both themes so her face reads the same.

nilo-pupil.$description: Pupils, closed-lid lines and the laptop code lines.

nilo-beak.$description: Amber beak. Same hue (80) as warn on purpose: amber is the second identity colour, attention and decision.

nilo-rim.$description: Spectacle frames, brow row and chest chevron: a lighter teal that reads on the body.

nilo-screen.$description: Laptop screen glow in the working pose, so it reads as lit at any size.

nilo-desk.$description: Laptop bezel and deck in the working pose.

nilo-code.$description: Code lines on the laptop screen.

shadow.$description: Elevation is value steps and hairlines first. Shadow only on floats and the composer.

space-2.$description: Gap between sibling controls; padding inside compact rows.

space-6.$description: Minimum breathing room around the conversation column.

space-12.$description: Top and bottom of the reading column.

radius.$description: design.md says 10px cards and 7px controls; globals.css ships 4, 6 and 8 and hardcodes 12, 14 and 18 in the composer and Studio welcome. Values here are what the code ships; the README lists the drift to resolve.

radius-panel.$description: Panels, list containers, React Flow controls (--r-panel).

radius-hero.$description: Studio welcome card only; candidate to fold into radius-composer.

control-lg.$description: Composer actions and sheet footers; also the minimum pointer target on touch layouts.

duration-base.$description: Surface hover, border and background change.

duration-enter.$description: Welcome and sheet entrance (oh-enter). Opacity and 8px translate only.

font.$description: Two families only. Sora for interface and display, IBM Plex Mono for machine data (ids, paths, tokens, code, keys). Both are self-hosted with next/font/local (frontend/src/app/fonts, SIL OFL 1.1) and preloaded; no font CDN at runtime. Reading text uses exactly three levels of ink: primary, dim, mute.

ui.$value: var(--font-sora, "Sora"), ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
ui.$description: Interface and display. --font-sora is defined by next/font/local; "Sora" is the fallback.

mono.$value: var(--font-plex-mono, "IBM Plex Mono"), ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "SFMono-Regular", Consolas, monospace
mono.$description: Machine data. --font-plex-mono is defined by next/font/local; "IBM Plex Mono" is the fallback.

t-display.$description: One per surface: empty-state and sheet headline. Sample: Pick a harness for this chat

t-title.$description: Panel and row titles, button labels. Sample: Provider readiness

t-body.$description: Dense tool UI: inspectors, lists, settings. The source's default. Sample: Choosing a provider that is not ready opens its setup right here.

t-reading.$description: Conversation column and long prose. design.md asks for generous reading text in Chats, but the app has no size above 13px for it. Sample: Paste an Anthropic key to send this message.

t-label.$description: Rare uppercase group label. design.md discourages dense all-caps: keep to one word, never in a running list. Sample: READY

t-meta.$description: Ids, model names, paths, timestamps, shortcut hints, set with tabular figures. Sample: claude-sonnet-5-5 · 200k ctx

t-code.$description: Code blocks and the run trace. Sample: OH_SECRETS=keychain
